meta.notes:
POST /webhook/super-enrich - Operator-initiated identity pivot for ONE selected individual per call (the dashboard fans out 1-5). Pivots from the corporate identity to the real-world persona: LinkedIn /lookup, maigret /search + socid /extract, then Flare exact-email search on each DISCOVERED alternate email (honouring WF09's "search known alternate emails, not a username keyword" contract), optional Flare firework deep events (reveal_events) for physical address/IP/device, and a password-reuse + format-fingerprint correlation across corp and personal accounts.

Body: {sketch_id, entity:{id,label}, company?, company_email_domain?, include_credentials, reveal_events, social_regions[], proxy{}, opsec{}}. sketch_id is injected by the frontend _scopeWebhookOpts.

Writes the discovered identity back onto the Individual (personal_emails, personal_phones, personal_location/address, locations_lived, work_history, specialty, social_* URLs) filling dossier slots read today but written by nobody, plus super_enriched flags and SocialProfile/FlareBreach nodes. Cleartext credential values ride ONLY the synchronous response when include_credentials is set and are NEVER written onto the Individual or its summary.
